item.title: Leh: Leh Airport to become India’s first geothermal and solar-powered airport by July, equipped with a special system
item.description: The Kushok Bakula Rinpoche Airport in Leh is undergoing a major renovation. This will make it India’s first airport to utilize both geothermal and solar energy.
